property_summary: For every owner-invoked withdraw(amount) when the contract has >= amount balance, the reference C always reduces address(c).balance by exactly amount (transfer reverts on failure); the mutant that uses call and ignores success can leave address(c).balance unchanged when the recipient deliberately reverts, violating this rule for some recipient behavior.
change_summary: Replaced transfer with call to send value, which forwards all gas and returns success bool; revert on failure was removed (so failed call won't revert), changing post-withdraw balance observable.
